Start with pod density: how many pods can fit on one m5.large? Use the formula: pods_per_node = min(floor(allocatable_cpu / pod_cpu_request), floor(allocatable_ram / pod_ram_request)). Effective allocatable = node_capacity × 0.9.
For m5.large (1.8 vCPU, 7.2 GiB usable): pods_by_cpu = floor(1.8/0.5) = 3, pods_by_ram = floor(7.2/1.0) = 7. CPU is the binding constraint — 3 pods/node. You need ceil(12/3) = 4 nodes.
